status.description: Reads the answer. Every other status arrives as an error body carrying recovery.

guide.description: Reads the domain document — markdown on how this thing is bought well: what it is bought on, what goes wrong and what that costs the buyer, what to trust, and what buying it online takes in place of handling it. It is what sil knows about the domain, so reason from it rather than reciting it, and never send the buyer to a shop it already tells you how to do without.

name.description: Calls the thing this in English — there is one, and this is it.

labels.description: Reads every other word for the thing — the market's own, in any language, folded to the form sil maps under. sil asks each index in them; the agent never sends them.

key.description: Names the key in the Brief and sends it as a `shopping_search` spec key.

display_name.description: Calls the key this when it writes it down or says it out loud.

description.description: Reads how this one key moves the fit — what it decides, what goes wrong at either end of it, and how a buyer's own fact becomes a value for it. Reason from it; ask from it; never recite it back.

type.description: Types the value the agent sends and reads for this key.

unit.description: States the value in this unit, the one sil holds it in.

allowed_values.description: Maps the buyer's word into the closed set; an enum without one takes any name, a maker's for `brand`.

operators.description: Picks the comparison that fits: `eq`/`in` on a variant spec and on enums, `gte`/`lte` on numbers and money.

step.description: Asks on the grid the maker prints the axis in — 0.5 for a Mondopoint size. A figure off the grid is something sil has not read as a value.

forms.description: Reads what pages print for a value, mapped to the value — `{"27/27.5": "27.5"}`. Never sent: the request takes the value, and this is how sil recognises it in the wild.

labels.description: Sends any of these as the key and reaches this one: the names sil maps here — the headings pages print it under and the keys other agents send for it, one mapping with no origin between them. Folded to the form the mapping stores, best-attested first, at most 20.

variant_spec.description: Settles these before searching when the buyer has not said them; expects their values under `variants[]`.

product_spec.description: Writes it into the brief when the buyer names it; never treats two products that differ on it as one.

specs.description: Builds predicates with keys the registry holds.
